verdict.rationale: Airwallex exposes dedicated APIs directly relevant to accounting workflows — the Card Expenses API for retrieving/syncing approved expenses into ERP/accounting systems and the Bills API for creating/managing vendor invoices (accounts payable) — which developers can use to view and manage accounting-adjacent data. However, there is no evidence of a broader, dedicated 'accounting' API covering ledger entries, chart of accounts, or full reconciliation beyond these spend-management endpoints. Missing for 10: evidence of a comprehensive accounting/ledger API, general ledger sync details, or third-party accounting software integration confirmation beyond bills/expenses.
